english:
A Weighted Knife that requires a 0.65 second wind-up before throwing. The throwing animation takes 1.55 seconds to complete.

Precision Kills grant a Class Ability Charge.

Hitting a <solar/>Scorched enemy causes an <solar Ignition />.

The knife deals <pve 571 /> <pvp [140] /> damage, and Precision Hits deal 150% of normal damage.

source.text:
Weighted Knife that requires a 0.65 second wind-up before throwing. Animation takes 1.55 seconds to complete.

Scoring a Precision Kill grant a Class Ability Charge.
Scoring a hit against a Scorched enemy causes an ignition.

Weighted Knife deals 571 [140] damage with a 1.5x Precision Multiplier.
Base Cooldown: 197.9 seconds

Chunk Scalar: 0.6x
